## Software & Analysis

We use a variety of software platforms to analyze passive acoustic data, including:

-   [MATLAB](https://www.mathworks.com/help/install/ug/install-products-with-internet-connection.html)
-   [Triton](https://www.cetus.ucsd.edu/technologies_triton.html)
-   [PAMGuard](https://www.pamguard.org/)
-   [Raven Pro](https://www.ravensoundsoftware.com/software/raven-pro/)
-   [R Studio](https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop)
-   [Python](https://www.python.org/)
